headword: {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}

definitions.gloss: overtime hours; hours of overtime work
definitions.explanation: The number of hours worked beyond regular working hours. A frequent topic in Japanese workplace discussions, especially regarding work-life balance and the legal cap on overtime.

examples.japanese: {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}が{長|なが}い。
{先月|せんげつ}の{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}は{四十時間|よんじゅうじかん}だった。
{法律|ほうりつ}で{月|つき}の{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}に{上限|じょうげん}が{定|さだ}められている。
examples.english: The law sets an upper limit on monthly overtime hours.

notes:
Compound of {残業|ざんぎょう} (overtime) + {時間|じかん} (hours, time). A central topic in discussions of Japanese working conditions and work-style reform ({働|はたら}き{方改革|かたかいかく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}が{長|なが}い: have long overtime hours
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce overtime hours
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}の{上限|じょうげん}: cap on overtime
- {月|つき}の{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}: monthly overtime hours

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese labor law caps overtime at 45 hours per month and 360 hours per year in principle, with stricter limits introduced by the 2019 work-style reform. Excessive overtime is associated with the social problem of {過労死|かろうし} (death from overwork).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残業|ざんぎょう}: overtime work (the activity itself)
- {残業代|ざんぎょうだい}: overtime pay
- {労働時間|ろうどうじかん}: working hours (total)
